input.replyBody:
Hi Emma,

Sorry about the unexpected charge. Your PawPlan subscription was bought through Apple on your iPhone. Deleting the app doesn't cancel an Apple subscription, so it stayed active and renewed on October 29.

We've set up the cancellation of your PawPlan subscription for you. Once it's processed, you won't be charged again, and the November 28 renewal won't happen.

What's left for you:
1. To double-check, open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions. PawPlan should show as cancelled.
2. Optional: if you'd like a refund for the October 29 charge ($29.99), you can ask Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple handles all billing for iPhone purchases, so we can't refund it on our side.

If anything still looks wrong, just reply here and we'll help.

Best,
PawPlan Support
